entities.summary: Mobile device management (MDM) is the administration of mobile devices, such as smartphones, tablet computers, and laptops. MDM is usually implemented with the use of a third-party product that has management features for particular vendors of mobile devices. Though closely related to Enterprise Mobility Management and Unified Endpoint Management, MDM differs slightly from both: unlike MDM, EMM includes mobile information management, BYOD, mobile application management and mobile content management, whereas UEM provides device management for endpoints like desktops, printers, IoT devices, and wearables.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The development of mobile device management (MDM) has enabled widespread adoption of personal mobile devices in enterprise settings, with significant impacts on productivity and security. By 2020, MDM had become a standard feature in many organizations worldwide.
